articles.title: Luxury litigation, poor pay the price
articles.description: The Supreme Court has issued a warning against what it terms 'luxury litigation', leading to the dismissal of a persistent case. With over 5.6 crore trials pending in India’s courts, the issue is severely hindering justice. Chronic vacancies and procedural inefficiencies are largely to blame. Wealthy individuals may bear the financial strain, while those less fortunate face ongoing challenges. Effective case management and expedited judicial appointments are essential for improvement.

articles.title: End of an era: Nasa begins search for successor to iconic T-38 Talons
articles.description: NASA is exploring options for replacing its aging T-38 Talon jet trainers. The space agency seeks aircraft with high reliability and modern avionics. This search comes as the Air Force plans its own T-38 fleet retirement. NASA will conduct a limited evaluation of potential replacement jets. Flexible acquisition methods are also being considered for the new fleet.
